name: CityEQA
description: An embodied question answering benchmark situated in city-like simulated environments to evaluate hierarchical LLM agents' navigation, perception, and question-answering performance.
evaluation_method: navigation success rate combined with question-answering accuracy (often reported as a composite of both)
general_score_metric: composite metric (navigation success rate paired with QA accuracy)
reputation: New EMNLP 2025 benchmark for embodied QA in city-like simulations with early-stage adoption in the embodied AI community.
notes: Simulated city environments imply a sim-to-real gap; benchmark measures embodied agent performance (not directly applicable to pure text LLMs); performance depends on both navigation and perception subsystems.
